cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Stevenson's, one of the country's major

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: manufacturers of metal goods.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: Thank you for choosing us for your two weeks of work experience.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: My name is Julia Simmons, and since the beginning of this year I've been the managing

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: director.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: Stevenson's is quite an old company.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: Like me, the founder, Ronald Stevenson, went into the steel industry when he left school

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: – that was in 1923.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: He set up this company when he finished his apprenticeship, in 1926, although he actually

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: started making plans two years earlier, in 1924. He was a very determined young man!

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: Stevenson's long-term plan was to manufacture components for the machine tools industry –

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: although in fact that never came about – and for the automotive industry, that is, cars

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: and lorries.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: However, there was a delay of five years before that happened, because shortly before the

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: company went into production, Stevenson was given the opportunity to make goods for

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: hospitals and other players in the healthcare industry, so that's what we did for the

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: first five years.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: Over the years, we've expanded the premises considerably – we were lucky that the site is

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: big enough, so moving to a new location has never been necessary.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: However, the layout is far from ideal for modern machinery and production methods, so we

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: intend to carry out major refurbishment of this site over the next five years.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: I'd better give you some idea of what you'll be doing during your two weeks with us, so

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: you know what to expect.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: Most mornings you'll have a presentation from one of the managers, to learn about their

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: department, starting this morning with research and development.

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: And you'll all spend some time in each department, observing what's going on and talking

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: to people – as long as you don't stop them from doing their work altogether!

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: In the past, a teacher from your school has come in at the end of each week to find out

cues.speaker: AH
cues.text: how the group were getting on, but your school isn't able to arrange that this year.
